stories.title: Fake nuclear alerts hit Ukraine and Russia after cyberattacks on emergency apps
stories.summary: Both countries said their emergency-alert apps were hacked to send false warnings, including nuclear threats, to millions late Sunday. The incidents raise concern about weaponizing public-safety alert systems during wartime.

stories.title: Truck bomb near Colombia military base kills four, including baby
stories.summary: An explosives-laden truck detonated near a military base in Planadas, Tolima, killing four people including a two-month-old baby. It is the latest attack in Colombia's worst wave of violence in a decade.

stories.title: India evacuates thousands ahead of Cyclone Murasu
stories.summary: Authorities began evacuating people along India's eastern coast, planning to move about 30,000, before the second cyclone in a week makes landfall. The region is still recovering from Cyclone Arnab, which killed six.

stories.title: LG CNS completes first overseas Korean-built AI data center in Jakarta
stories.summary: The 30-megawatt hyperscale facility, built for a Sinar Mas–Korea Investment joint venture, is the first AI data center a South Korean firm has delivered for an overseas client and can scale to 400 MW.

stories.title: South Korea pledges roughly $16B for AI in its 2027 budget
stories.summary: President Lee Jae Myung's record budget routes about 21.3 trillion won across AI semiconductors, physical AI and domestic AI data centers, nearly doubling 2026's allocation.

stories.title: Browns fall 27-6 in Pittsburgh for a record-tying 23rd straight road loss
stories.summary: Cleveland turned the ball over on its first two drives and allowed eight sacks in a lopsided defeat that ties the NFL record for consecutive road losses against one opponent. Harold Fannin Jr.'s 154 receiving yards was one of few bright spots.

stories.title: Kimi Antonelli becomes youngest F1 champion in history at age 20
stories.summary: The Mercedes driver finished third in Mexico City to seal the 2026 drivers' title, breaking Sebastian Vettel's 2010 record for the youngest world champion.

stories.title: F1 grid praises new world champion Kimi Antonelli
stories.summary: Rival drivers reacted to Antonelli's historic title, with Carlos Sainz calling it 'completely deserved' after the Italian clinched the championship with a P3 finish in Mexico.

stories.title: Early voting wraps up with strong turnout ahead of Election Day
stories.summary: More than 93,000 Franklin County residents voted early at the county vote center this year, with long lines and waits of up to two hours on the final day Sunday. There is no early voting Monday before Tuesday's election.

stories.title: Franklin County releases final early voting totals, Election Day reminders
stories.summary: A total of 93,166 voters cast in-person early ballots, while more than 12,000 mailed ballots had not yet been received as of Sunday. Officials urge voters to confirm polling locations, with 54,000 residents assigned to new precincts.
